svd.description:
One stored fit over embedded sequences.

Its source is `embeddings_job_id`, an earlier embeddings job whose features and
sequences it fits on, or `model_id` with `sequences` or `assay_id`. The embedding
params are those of the feature model's `batch/embeddings`.

model_id.description: System embeddings model behind the fit.

umap.description:
A UMAP fit of embedded sequences.

Its source is `embeddings_job_id`, or `model_id` with `sequences` or `assay_id`.
`model_id` is a system model (PLM features) or a fitted SVD (SVD features).
